description:
Learn software system design and pass interviews. This course provides a practical five-step framework for structuring your thinking and tackling vague requirements under pressure. Additionally, the course walks through real-world examples, designing systems similar to Spotify, Booking.com, WhatsApp from scratch.

Course from @hayk.simonyan 

Become a senior software engineer with a job guarantee: https://hayksimonyan.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=177-system-design-interview-guide&utm_content=august-2026
